facts.function: sorts pulverized coal particles by size in the mill (dynamic classifier)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8474 covers sorting, screening, separating machines for mineral substances in solid form; coal is a mineral substance

rejected_alternatives.reason: crushing or grinding machines; the classifier separates rather than grinds
parts line; applies if the classifier is imported as a component of a pulverizer
residual machines; H192319 placed separator machines there, but mineral-substance sorting machines are provided for in 8474.10
gas-filtering/purifying; classifier sorts solids by size

missing_facts: Whether it is imported as a complete machine or as part of a pulverizer (would be 8474.90)
classification.rationale: A classifier in a coal mill separates pulverized coal by particle size. That is a stationary separating machine for mineral substances in solid form under 8474.10. No ruling on this exact good appeared in the tool results, so none is cited.
